sod_rules.risk: Create a vendor and pay it
Create a vendor and enter its invoices
Enter and approve the same invoice
Raise and approve the same purchase order
Prepare and approve the same payment run
Post and approve the same journal
Create an employee and pay them
Run and approve the same payroll
Approve payroll and release the bank file
Administer the domain and run payments
Full ERP authority and payment approval

controls.name: Joiners: every account belongs to a current employee
controls.objective: No account exists without a person in HR to own it, and none was created before that person joined.
controls.test: Join every account on the four systems to the HR master by employee ID; flag accounts with no HR record, or created before the hire date.

frameworks.COBIT 2019: DSS05.04 Manage user identity and logical access
frameworks.SOX ITGC: Logical access — access is provisioned to authorised users

controls.name: Leavers: access is removed when employment ends
controls.objective: A terminated employee's accounts are disabled by the next business day.
controls.test: For every employee terminated in the period, every account they held: disabled on or before termination + 1 business day; still enabled at the extract date is a failure, disabled late is a failure.

frameworks.ISO/IEC 27001:2022: A.5.18 Access rights; A.6.5 Responsibilities after termination
frameworks.SOX ITGC: Logical access — access is removed timely on termination

controls.name: Movers: access matches the current role
controls.objective: An employee holds only the entitlements the role-based access model assigns to their current role, or an approved exception.
controls.test: Compare each active employee's entitlements to ROLE_ENTITLEMENTS for their current role; excess entitlements without an approved exception ticket are failures. Employees who changed role in the period are reported separately: their excess is what the move left behind.

frameworks.COBIT 2019: DSS05.04; DSS06.03 Manage roles, responsibilities, access privileges
frameworks.SOX ITGC: Logical access — access is appropriate to job responsibilities

controls.name: Privileged access is restricted and named
controls.objective: Domain admin, ERP SAP_ALL and payroll bank-file release are held only by roles entitled to them, on named accounts.
controls.test: Every privileged entitlement: the holder's role includes it, the account is a named personal account (not generic or shared), and the holder is an active employee.

frameworks.SOX ITGC: Logical access — privileged access is restricted

controls.name: Dormant accounts are disabled
controls.objective: An enabled account that has not been used in 90 days is disabled.
controls.test: Enabled accounts with last logon more than 90 days before the extract date, or never used and created more than 90 days before it.

controls.name: Access changes are authorised
controls.objective: Every grant of an entitlement in the period was requested in a ticket and approved by someone other than the requester or the beneficiary.
controls.test: Every grant event in the period: a ticket exists, its status is approved, the approver is not the beneficiary and not the requester, and the approver is a manager or the system owner.

frameworks.COBIT 2019: DSS05.04; BAI06 (for access as a change)
frameworks.SOX ITGC: Logical access — access requests are approved

controls.name: Segregation of duties
controls.objective: No one holds a combination of entitlements that lets them complete a fraud alone.
controls.test: For every active employee, every SOD_RULES pair held together, across systems; a conflict without a documented mitigating control is a failure.

frameworks.SOX ITGC: Segregation of duties within key financial processes

controls.name: Expense claims: fraud analytics
controls.objective: Not a control test — a set of analytics on the year's expense claims that an auditor runs to direct substantive work.
controls.test: Benford's law on first digits, by department; claims just under the approval limit; duplicate claims (same claimant, amount and date); claims approved by the claimant; round-amount frequency.
